method: All retained nested points with normalized log weights; weighted inverse-CDF equal-tail intervals and empirical CDF sup distance. Mean shifts use pooled posterior SD, not standard error.
caveats: All runs use the same injection/noise recipe and sampler seed; these are not independent Monte Carlo replicates.
The two 1024-bin runs are numerically duplicate posteriors and are shown as one curve.
Hardware, source revision, sampler execution and likelihood representation changed together; this does not isolate the allocator effect.
Weight ESS does not establish independent samples; no KS p-values or significance claims are made.
Raw polarization CDF depends on equivalent-mode weights; folded polarization tests orientation within its pi/2 symmetry.
Agreement between approximate posteriors is not a dense posterior-wide likelihood validation or proof of mixing.
